finding.claim: c4 is ORed into the output byte without checking for -1, producing String.fromCharCode(0xFFFFFFFF)=65535 instead of breaking like c1/c2/c3 do.
finding.title: base64_decode missing invalid-character check for c4

verifier.reason: Confirmed at index.js:492-495: c4 gets the -1 fallback and is ORed into o and pushed via String.fromCharCode(o) with no c4==-1 break, unlike c3 at index.js:486, so o becomes -1 and fromCharCode yields 65535.

repro.expectedBehavior: decodeBase64 stops decoding at an invalid character, as it does for c3, returning only bytes decoded before that character.
